description: Use of value after move
rationale: Moved values have undefined state
fix_template: Clone the value before the move, or restructure to use a reference

description: Value moved twice
rationale: A value can only be moved once

description: Value moved inside loop iteration
rationale: Loop body runs multiple times; value consumed on first iteration
fix_template: Clone inside loop or move value before loop

description: Partial move out of struct
rationale: Field moved but struct still referenced
fix_template: Move entire struct or clone the field

description: Value moved into closure but used after
rationale: Closure takes ownership; value unavailable after
fix_template: Use reference in closure or clone

description: Value dropped while still borrowed
rationale: Reference outlives its referent
fix_template: Extend the value's lifetime or shorten the borrow

description: Implicit copy of large struct (>256 bytes)
rationale: Large copies are expensive; prefer reference or clone explicitly

description: Owned value created but never used
rationale: Unnecessary allocation

description: Returning reference to local variable
rationale: Local variable dropped at end of function

description: Cannot move out of a shared reference
rationale: Shared references don't grant ownership

description: Unnecessary Box allocation for small type
rationale: Value fits on stack — heap allocation is overhead

description: Potential Rc reference cycle detected
rationale: Rc cycles cause memory leaks

description: Arc used in single-threaded context
rationale: Arc overhead unnecessary without concurrency

description: Cow never clones — always borrows
rationale: Cow overhead unnecessary if never owned

description: mem::forget called — value leaked intentionally?
rationale: Forgetting values skips Drop; may leak resources

description: Potential double-free via manual drop
rationale: Drop called explicitly then scope-end drop runs again

description: Move out of Option without take()
rationale: Leaves Option in undefined state

description: Self-referential struct detected
rationale: Moving the struct invalidates internal pointers

description: Vec reused after into_iter() consumes it
rationale: into_iter moves the Vec

description: String moved during concatenation
rationale: format! or + operator may consume the string

description: Generic parameter requires move semantics
rationale: T without Copy bound will be moved
fix_template: Add Copy bound or use references

description: Destructuring moves fields out of struct
rationale: Pattern match can partially move struct fields
fix_template: Use ref in pattern or clone

description: Temporary value dropped too early
rationale: Expression result dropped before reference used

description: Manual swap can use std::mem::swap
rationale: Swap idiom is clearer and avoids temporaries

description: clone() called on Copy type
rationale: Copy types are bitwise-copied; .clone() is redundant

description: Use mem::take to replace value with default
rationale: mem::take is cleaner than manual replace with Default

description: Closure captures environment by move
rationale: All referenced variables will be moved into the closure

description: Use entry API instead of contains-then-insert
rationale: Entry API avoids double lookup

description: Use drain() when values should be processed before clearing
rationale: drain() yields ownership of elements

description: iter() borrows, into_iter() moves, iter_mut() borrows mutably
rationale: Choose iterator method based on ownership needs

description: PhantomData marks type as owning T for drop-check
rationale: Used for variance and drop-check

description: ManuallyDrop used — ensure value is properly handled
rationale: Value will not be dropped automatically

description: Pinned values cannot be moved unless Unpin
rationale: Pin guarantees address stability

description: Prefer to_owned() on borrowed types, clone() on owned
rationale: to_owned() is idiomatic for &str → String

description: Use .into() for type conversions instead of explicit constructors
rationale: Into trait provides idiomatic conversions

description: Vec::with_capacity reduces reallocations when size is known
rationale: Pre-allocating avoids repeated heap allocations

description: String::with_capacity reduces reallocations when length is known
rationale: Pre-allocating avoids repeated heap allocations

description: Box::leak creates a 'static reference — memory never freed
rationale: Intentional leak; ensure this is desired

description: mem::transmute changes type but not ownership semantics
rationale: Transmute may violate ownership invariants

description: Struct fields dropped in declaration order
rationale: Drop order can matter for resource cleanup
